title: MLX_OMARCHY_DENSE_GEMV paired identity+performance gate, candidate 8bf15b3, native M1 (Linux aarch64)

decision.not_a_claim: This is NOT a correctness-pass on the whole model. It is a paired A/B gate on one 4-bit 0.5B model with digest-level identity checks.
decision.rationale: DENSE_GEMV=1 changed long-decode-128 output on ALL 5 ON runs (digest f873dc2bdd34c0fe vs canonical 4cc08910089477fd). An output-changing optimization cannot ship as a default. ON-side long128 timings (+5.28% median decode) are NOT comparable because the output changed. Digest-level PASS on short32 and ctx1024 plus their timing deltas (decode +1.56% and +14.51% median) remain hypothesis-grade only.

integration: Candidate removed from integration source after the failed gate; retained on the dense-gemv/m1-decode experimental branch.
identity_gate_note: The paired matrix retained 64-bit digests, not full generated-ID arrays. Its full-ID preservation requirement was not met. Matching digests do not prove full-stream identity; the first differing long128 token index is unknown. The separate short32 smoke below contains full arrays and has its own limited identity evidence.

wheel.sha256_status: recorded by orchestrator at build time; wheel not present on this workstation so not re-hashed here

installed_binary_provenance_per_run.upstream_mlx: source install, no dist metadata; mx reports 0.32.2.dev202609042003+8bf15b3

commands.driver_script_verbatim:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
B=$HOME/benchq/logs/dense-gate-8bf15b3cbd41c29347000ca19a7f207f1cfaaba3
H=$HOME/src/mlx-matrix-harness-a34cdc5
MANIFEST=$HOME/benchq/logs/performance-final-db10f53-20260904-batch4/manifest.q4-compile-unset.json
PY=$HOME/benchq/perf-build.sH4lFbqd/venv/bin/python
WHEEL=$HOME/benchq/perf-build.sH4lFbqd/mlx_omarchy-0.32.2.dev202609042003+8bf15b3-cp314-cp314-linux_aarch64.whl
cd "$H"
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  if [ $((i % 2)) -eq 1 ]; then order="off on"; else order="on off"; fi
  for side in $order; do
    if [ "$side" = off ]; then export MLX_OMARCHY_DENSE_GEMV=0; else export MLX_OMARCHY_DENSE_GEMV=1; fi
    export MLX_OMARCHY_FUSED_CHAIN=0 MLX_OMARCHY_ROPE_BF16_DIRECT=0 MLX_OMARCHY_SDPA_BF16_FAST=0
    unset MLX_OMARCHY_QMM_TILE MLX_DISABLE_COMPILE MLX_OMARCHY_GPU_PROFILE
    echo "[$(date -Is)] pair$i $side DENSE=$MLX_OMARCHY_DENSE_GEMV start" >> "$B/pairs.progress"
    env -u MLX_DISABLE_COMPILE "$PY" scripts/bench_matrix.py --mode run --manifest "$MANIFEST" --python "$PY" --wheel "$WHEEL" --host-label jwm1-linux --out "$B/pair$i-$side.json" > "$B/pair$i-$side.stdout" 2>&1
    echo "[$(date -Is)] pair$i $side exit=$?" >> "$B/pairs.progress"
  done
done
echo PAIRS_DONE >> "$B/pairs.progress"
